questions.question_english: A pair of forces of equal magnitude but acting in opposite direction with different lines of action is known as?
questions.question_hindi: समान परिमाण के बलयुग्म जो विभिन्न रेखा में विपरीत दिशा में कार्यरत हैं, को क्या कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation_english: A pair of forces of equal magnitude but acting in opposite direction with different lines of action is known as couple. A couple produces rotation without translation. Example- (i) There is a couple acting on the compass needle due to the earth's magnetic field. (ii) When we open the lid of a bottle by turning it, our fingers are applying a couple to the lid.
